product.name: tanX Cross-Chain Orderbook DEX
product.description: A decentralized exchange platform enabling trustless trading of multiple crypto assets across various blockchain networks with optimized pricing and gasless transactions.

product.name: tanX Cross-Chain Bridging Service
product.description: A service that enables users to transfer crypto assets seamlessly and trustlessly between supported blockchain networks like Ethereum, Optimism, Scroll, Polygon, Mode Network, and Starknet.

product.name: SALT Loyalty and Incentive Program
product.description: A points-based system that rewards users with trading discounts, leaderboard prizes, and referral rebates based on their trading activity and community engagement on tanX.
